abstract: Risk factors for benign ovarian teratomas have been analysed in a case-control study conducted in Milan. Cases were women aged less than 65 years with a histologically confirmed diagnosis of benign ovarian teratoma who were admitted to a network of Obstetrics and Gynecology Departments in Milan. A total of 77 women aged 16-64 years were interviewed. Controls were women admitted to hospital for acute, non-gynaecological, non-hormonal and non-neoplastic diseases; 231 controls were interviewed (age range 15-64 years). Cases tended to be more educated: in comparison with women with less than 7 years of education, the estimated relative risk (RR) of ovarian benign teratoma was 1.6 and 2.5 respectively in women with 7-11 and 12 or more years of schooling, the trend in risk being statistically significant (chi 2(1) trend 5.39, P < 0.01). Four of the 77 cases (5.2%) and two of the 231 controls (0.9%) reported a history of infertility, with a corresponding RR of 8.3 (95% confidence interval 1.3-54.0). There was no clear relation between parity and risk of ovarian benign teratomas: in comparison with nulliparae, the estimated RRs were 1.1 and 0.7 respectively in women reporting one or two or more births (chi 2(1) trend 0.53, P = not significant). No relation emerged between marital status, age at menarche, menstrual cycle pattern, menopausal status, abortions, age at first pregnancy, oral contraceptive use and risk of ovarian benign teratomas.
abstract_ja: ミラノで行われた症例対照研究で良性卵巣奇形腫の危険因子を分析した。対象は、組織学的に良性卵巣奇形腫と確定診断され、ミラノの産婦人科施設ネットワークに入院した65歳未満の女性77名とした。対照は、急性の非婦人科疾患、非ホルモン性かつ非腫瘍性疾患で入院した女性であり、231名（年齢15～64歳）に面接を行った。教育年数が7年未満の女性と比べ、7～11年および12年以上の女性における良性奇形腫の推定相対危険度（RR）はそれぞれ1.6および2.5であり、リスクの傾向は統計学的に有意であった（χ2(1)トレンド5.39、P < 0.01）。不妊歴は症例77名中4名（5.2%）、対照231名中2名（0.9%）に認められ、対応するRRは8.3（95%信頼区間1.3～54.0）であった。経産回数と良性卵巣奇形腫のリスクとの明確な関連は認められず、未産婦と比べた推定RRは、出産1回または2回以上の女性でそれぞれ1.1および0.7であった（χ2(1)トレンド0.53、P=有意差なし）。婚姻状況、初経年齢、月経周期のパターン、閉経状態、流産歴、初回妊娠年齢、経口避妊薬の使用と良性卵巣奇形腫のリスクとの間には、いずれも関連が認められなかった。
